name: Physically Robust Mesh Deformation with Regularized Projection
definition: An optimization formulation to jointly optimize the locations of projected vertices to avoid imprecise predictions, non-uniform distortion, and flipping artifacts.
summary: Physically Robust Mesh Deformation with Regularized Projection optimizes volumetric tetrahedral mesh vertices to eliminate flipping artifacts and distortion by combining robust projection with smoothness and orientation regularization terms.
